channel.title: Libya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Libya, every source cited.

item.title: Libyan dialogue group seeks judicial unity for elections
item.description: London talks focus on resolving institutional divisions to enable credible presidential and parliamentary votes.

item.title: Libya restarts Brega gas unit
item.description: Sirte Oil Company recovers 60 million cubic feet of gas daily that would otherwise be flared.

item.title: LAICO approves changes to protect overseas assets
item.description: Libyan African Investment Company's general assembly reviewed business plans and adopted new regulations on October 29.

item.title: France warns citizens against travel to most of Libya
item.description: French authorities advise against travel to Tripoli due to volatile security, armed clashes, and crime risks.

item.title: Libyan professor links wage reform to spending control
item.description: Ali Al-Sharif stated that managing oil revenues transparently is key to closing wage gaps.
